item.title: Federal appeals court pauses Minnesota's AI nudification ban
item.description: Minnesota's law banning AI "nudification" images has been put on hold after a federal appeals court sided with Elon Musk's artificial intelligence company.

item.title: ShinyHunters hacker detained in Jordan, cooperating with FBI, sources say
item.description: ShinyHunters, a notorious cybercrime group, has claimed, without public verification, that it obtained data on every FBI employee.

item.title: Search ongoing after debris of plane found off Nantucket
item.description: Debris has been found of a medical jet with six people on board that went missing near Nantucket while flying from Bermuda to Boston early Saturday.

item.title: Zach Bryan wears "Free Palestine" shirt during concert at Gillette Stadium
item.description: After Macklemore was barred from opening for Ed Sheeran at Gillette Stadium for pro-Palestinian comments, musician Zach Bryan wore a "Free Palestine" shirt during his Friday show.

item.title: 2 dead, dozens injured in Georgia block party shooting
item.description: Two people were killed and another 35 were hospitalized with injuries after a shooting broke out at a neighborhood block party in Georgia, authorities said.

item.title: Senior Trump administration officials met to discuss Iran war at Camp David
item.description: Vice President JD Vance, Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth were among the officials to meet on Friday to discuss a path forward.

item.title: The Alito Court: A rare interview with the influential Supreme Court justice
item.description: Justice Samuel Alito discussed his opinion in the Dobbs decision overturning Roe v. Wade, the leaked draft and its aftermath, same-sex marriage rights and why he's not retiring yet.

item.title: More details emerge about FlyDubai co-pilot who tried to crash plane
item.description: Questions about the motive of the co-pilot who tried to crash a packed flight from Dubai to Israel continue to swirl.

item.title: CBS News poll finds Democrats maintain House advantage amid concern about prices
item.description: Here are 10 things to know about the 2026 midterm elections, in no particular order, based on what voters are telling us today.

item.title: Energy Secretary: Trump was "aware of the risks to energy flows" before Iran war
item.description: Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that President Trump was "well aware of the risks to energy flows" before launching the war in Iran earlier this year, but argued "the world cannot sustain a nuclear-armed Iran."

item.title: Samuel Alito says that political attacks aimed at Supreme Court can be "quite damaging"
item.description: As the Supreme Court is set to start its new term, Supreme Court justice Samuel Alito sat down with CBS News' Jan Crawford in a rare interview ahead of the release of his new book, saying that political attacks aimed at the high court -- most recently by President Trump on his social media platform -- "can be quite damaging."

item.title: Zach Lahn, Iowa's GOP governor candidate, says the state's farmers "really have a problem"
item.description: Zach Lahn, the Republican candidate for governor in Iowa, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that he believes the state's "farmers understand that for a long time they have been treated as price takers, and really the deck has been stacked against them. And now when you add in the higher cost of diesel, we really have a problem."

item.title: Face the Nation: Lahn, McGurk
item.description: Missed the second half of the show? CBS News correspondent Matt Gutman reports, Iowa GOP nominee for governor Zach Lahn and top Biden Middle East adviser Brett McGurk join.

item.title: Biden adviser Brett McGurk recalls "pretty draconian measures" being considered against Israel
item.description: Brett McGurk, who served as a top adviser to President Biden on the Middle East, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" about the high-stakes negotiations between Israel and Hamas, and how the Biden administration was considering "pretty draconian measures against Israel" in April 2024.

item.title: CBS News Battleground Tracker poll finds Democrats maintain House advantage
item.description: A new CBS News Battleground Tracker poll finds that if the midterm elections were held today, Democrats would hold a 229-206 advantage over Republicans in the U.S. House, giving Democrats the majority. CBS News director of elections and surveys Anthony Salvanto digs into the new CBS News poll.

item.title: Energy Secretary says Trump was "aware of the risks to energy flows" before launching Iran war
item.description: Energy Secretary Chris Wright told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that President Trump was "well aware of the risks to energy flows" before launching the Iran war, but he said the president said "I simply cannot. The world cannot sustain a nuclear-armed Iran, and I'm not going to do it."

item.title: Key Biden aide recalls "draconian measures" being considered against Israel
item.description: In a CBS News interview, Biden-era Middle East adviser Brett McGurk recounted the administration's response to the Oct. 7 attack, its handling of the Israel-Hamas war, the role of Iran and the long-sought push to normalize relations between Israel and Saudi Arabia.

item.title: FlyDubai co-pilot was likely lone wolf, Israeli investigators believe
item.description: The FlyDubai​ alleged attempted hijacking was likely a lone wolf attack, an early investigation by Israel shows, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.description: This week on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan," CBS News executive director of elections and surveys Anthony Salvanto discusses the latest polls as the final countdown to the midterm elections begin. Plus, Iowa's GOP nominee for governor, Zach Lahn, and Democratic Sen. Mark Kelly join.

item.title: U.S. Marine arrested, accused of killing Japanese woman in Okinawa
item.description: U.S. authorities in Japan acknowledged that a U.S. service member was in police custody and pledged to fully cooperate with the investigation.

item.title: Trump announces AI "Super Intelligence Force"
item.description: President Trump announced the formation of a "Super Intelligence Force" after meeting with leaders of the country's largest artificial intelligence companies last week.

item.title: Latino Dems urge investment in Hinojosa campaign as Texas governor's race tightens
item.description: Latino Democratic leaders are renewing calls for the Democratic Governors Association to invest more heavily in Texas after a new poll showed Gina Hinojosa narrowly leading Republican Gov. Greg Abbott.

item.title: Trump likely to pick Jay Clayton for AI czar, sources say
item.description: Jay Clayton will likely be the White House's pick for AI czar, and the Trump administration has been discussing having him remain in his current role as director of national intelligence, according to sources briefed on the matter.
